title: Michael Seibel - Building Product
summary: Y Combinator CEO Michael Seibel lectures at Startup School on building a product people want: identifying the problem, the customer, an MVP and which customers to pursue first.
why: HN commenters point to it as practical YC advice on iterating on a product and talking to users.

quote.text: Watched this lecture by Michael Seibel to YC in 2018 and thought it was useful.
